prerequisites: Course succeeds to compulsory courses of previous semester

learning_outcomes.text: Students will understand the basic issues and terminology of combustion engine for vehicles.
They can describe components of the internal combustion engine.
Student will be able to describe the principle of operation of the internal combustion engine.
Will be able to define the ideal thermodynamic cycles and will be able to compare the different cycles among themselves.
They will understand the formation of mixture and they will understand to gas exchange process.
And they will be able to describe accessory of combustion engines.

syllabus_topics: Definition and classification of internal combustion engines, the historical progression of combustion engines.
Characteristic parameters of internal combustion engines.
Fuel mixture preparation and gas exhcange process
The basic components of internal combustion engines.
Emissions of combustion engine and its impact on the environment.
Kinematics and dynamics of the crank mechanism
teaching_methods: Teaching by an expert (lecture or tutorial)
